title: WCLD: Curated Large Dataset of Criminal Cases from Wisconsin Circuit Courts

bias_targets.methodology: Training machine learning classifiers (Logistic Regression and XGBoost) on the curated dataset to predict recidivism, and comparing fairness and classification performance metrics (such as False Positive Rate, False Negative Rate, Positive Rate, Accuracy, and AUC) across five different racial demographic groups (Caucasian, African American, Hispanic, Native American, and Asian).
